app.tagline: The artistic cycling basketball prediction game

auth.nicknameHint: 3–20 characters. Shown publicly in the ranking and on the big screen.
auth.privacyHint: We only store your nickname and password (encrypted) – no e-mail, no real names.
auth.forgotHint: Forgot your password? The tournament staff can reset it.

home.claim: Predict the games, collect points, beat the hall.
home.loginHint: Create an account in 10 seconds – just a nickname and password.
home.empty: No prediction game is running right now.

join.title: Join the prediction game
join.text_one: {{count}} person is playing so far. Predict every game whose teams are known – until kick-off.
join.text_other: {{count}} people are playing so far. Predict every game whose teams are known – until kick-off.
join.loginFirst: Log in or sign up to make predictions.

tips.stale: The pairing has changed – please predict again.
tips.pendingHint: Open for predictions as soon as both teams are known.
tips.showStats_one: How did the hall predict? ({{count}} prediction)
tips.showStats_other: How did the hall predict? ({{count}} predictions)
tips.shootoutNote: Scored on the result after regular time (without free-throw shoot-out).
tips.allDoneHint: New games appear as soon as their teams are known.

hints.top_scorer: Which player scores the most points?
hints.most_penalty_seconds: Who collects the most penalty seconds?
hints.group_winner: Who finishes first in the group?
hints.total_baskets: How many points are scored in total (regular time)? Closest guess wins.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.liveHint: Live: points from the running game count provisionally.

stats.title: Stats
stats.hiddenUntilLock: The distribution is shown after kick-off.
stats.noMatches: Stats appear from the first kick-off.
stats.hiddenUntilKickoff: You can see the others' predictions from kick-off.
stats.quoteHint: Odds = 1 ÷ share of predictions. The higher, the bolder.

me.deleteConfirm: Delete your account and all predictions for good?

rules.title: Rules & points
rules.matchTipsText: Predict the score after regular time. You can predict until kick-off.
rules.koAdvance: Knockout: draw predicted and correct team through
rules.notCumulative: Only the highest matching level counts.
rules.joker_one: Joker: {{count}}× per phase (group/KO) – doubles the points of one game. Can be moved until kick-off.
rules.joker_other: Joker: {{count}}× per phase (group/KO) – doubles the points of one game. Can be moved until kick-off.
rules.underdog: Underdog bonus: +{{bonus}} if your outcome is right and at most {{pct}} % predicted it (from {{min}} predictions).
rules.formula: Points = (base + KO bonus) × multiplier × joker + underdog.
rules.specialsText: Special bets close with the tournament's first kick-off. In case of a tie (e.g. two top scorers) all hits count.
rules.lock: From kick-off a game is locked – technically too.
rules.hidden: You only see the others' predictions after kick-off.
rules.tiebreak: Tie-break: more exact predictions, then differences, then outcomes.
rules.late: Joining late means 0 points for missed games.
rules.live: During a game, points count provisionally with the current score.

errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.CALLIT_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts. Please try later.
errors.CALLIT_TOO_MANY_REGISTRATIONS: Too many sign-ups. Please try later.
errors.CALLIT_NOT_AVAILABLE: There is no prediction game for this tournament.
errors.CALLIT_REGISTRATION_CLOSED: Registration for the prediction game is closed.
errors.CALLIT_DISQUALIFIED: You have been excluded from this prediction game.
errors.CALLIT_MATCH_LOCKED: Too late – the game has already started.
errors.CALLIT_MATCH_PENDING: The teams are not known yet.
errors.CALLIT_JOKER_USED: The joker for this phase is already used.
